routes.label: Creator-supplied subtitles/captions
routes.restrictions: Can upload a caption file, auto-sync eligible transcript or type manually; source text and timing require review; not a dubbing or speech replacement tool

routes.label: Automatically recognized original-language captions
routes.restrictions: May not appear promptly or correctly for accents, dialects, noise, overlapping speakers and unsupported languages; review and correct

routes.label: Translated title and description
routes.restrictions: Translated titles and descriptions may be discoverable to viewers in that language, but search queries and viewers are not measured

routes.label: Creator-uploaded alternate audio
routes.restrictions: The feature is not universally available; creator must produce/upload a supported audio-only file and have rights to the track

routes.label: Eligible automatic dubbed audio
routes.restrictions: Video longer than 120 minutes may be ineligible; tracks can be mistranslated; creator cannot edit generated dubbed audio directly

routes.label: Viewer audio and metadata language preference
routes.restrictions: Preferred language setting is distinct from app language and location, and does not change search results or recommendations

critical_boundaries: A caption track is not an additional original audio track; translated metadata, ASR, manual dubbing and automatic dubbing are different creator workflows.
Original-language automatic captions are not guaranteed for all languages, dialects or recordings and must not be treated as complete observed transcripts.
Publisher auto-dubbing availability depends on channel eligibility and source-target language support; do not create a fixed universal language-pair table.
The 120-minute automatic dubbing exclusion is not a maximum length for all uploads or manual subtitles.
Viewers' preferred language selection does not imply a measured change to algorithmic recommendations or search volume.
A multilingual title does not make an impression count, deduplicated multilingual audience or revenue measurement.
All costs of translation, editing, re-recording, accessibility testing and correction remain unknown without creator records.
Source documents establish possible features, not the actual presence of subtitles, voice quality, an approved account or monetization.
